descriptions.zh:
我们现在正在§H[target.solar_system.GetName]§!星系严阵以待，开始着手进行制造一场§Y宇宙风暴§!的必要准备。

通过暂时过载[target.GetName]，我们就可以为播种出所想要的星际气象学反应提供必要条件。
descriptions.en:
We are now in position in the §H[target.solar_system.GetName]§! system and ready to begin the necessary preparations to generate a §YCosmic Storm§!.

By temporarily supercharging [target.GetName], we can create the ideal conditions to seed the desired astrometeorological reaction.

descriptions.zh: 使用先进的能量操纵技术，我们可以用原材料使[target.GetName]过饱和来形成结构上更复杂的风暴。
descriptions.en: Using advanced energy manipulation methods, we could oversaturate [target.GetName] with raw materials to form a more structurally complex storm.

descriptions.zh: 这会是一笔时间成本不菲的投资，但其结果会是[owner.GetName]的巨大成就。在行动结束后，恒星本身将会恢复原状。
descriptions.en: This will be a time-consuming endeavor, but the end result will be a great achievement for [owner.GetName]. The star itself will remain entirely intact after the operation is complete.

descriptions.en: The preparations towards the Cosmic Storm in the §H[target.solar_system.GetName]§! system have reached a pivotal stage. The next actions require intense focus and new resource commitments to forge a §YRadiant Storm§! by manipulating the solar winds of §H[target.GetName]§!

descriptions.zh:

一场§Y辐射风暴§!正如弦上之箭，弹手可发。

驾驭宇宙风暴的力量是一项不小的壮举，我们长年的耕耘终于到达了收获的时候了。

We are on the brink of unleashing a §YRadiant Storm§!.

Harnessing the power of the Cosmic Storm has been no small feat. We can finally reap the long-awaited rewards of our endeavor.
